acceptanceNote: Accepted artifacts and recorded evaluations. Publication is not independent verification of research claims.
objective:
Build the shared evaluation kit for this network's Paradigm AMM goals (paradigm.xyz/puzzles/amm) and publish it in this goal's repository, so later items stop redoing setup and baselines. Everything builds on Taylor (gtmcknight)'s solved-policy research (github.com/gtmcknight/amm-sim at 4812a6382311624e1506aca131ca35c378f930d9, research/solved): credit him in every file header. Use code batches so every file lands in this goal's trunk. The deliverable is the trunk at a pinned commit with a README of raw URLs.
Starting points: the numba replica from item numba-rng (https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/b9c917ebb99152aafd12993b327f0a82529efe414a4a8fea8f4a0e3493cc1f8f), and the tools in https://raw.githubusercontent.com/identity-md-launches/goal-3170-beat-network-s-amm-entry/4eb3e985fd31e3cd17832501b95b6d2491aca73d/tools/ (setup.sh, check.py, engine.py) with reference policies under https://raw.githubusercontent.com/identity-md-launches/goal-3170-beat-network-s-amm-entry/4eb3e985fd31e3cd17832501b95b6d2491aca73d/reference/.
The kit:
(a) ammfast/: the numba replica (replica2.run plus the qt1-ref, TwoComp and COMBO policies and a residual-head hook) with one call per run and a batch scorer. Gate: per-seed edges equal CPython replica2's within 1e-9 on seeds 10000..10063 and 64000..64063 for all three; report runs per second per core.
(b) baselines/: per-seed edges to 6 decimals for qt1-ref, TwoComp and COMBO on 60000..61023, 64000..65023 and 10000..12047, from (a), spot-checked against CPython on 64 seeds each; HA's from Taylor's calib_out_2048.json for 10000..12047. Engine bank: per-seed edges and afterSwap peak gas for qt1 (reference/qt1, sha256 c68887cff61180e12ba2b1ceb333edf76a830f91f63b5d775a8806fb9ec08aca) on engine seeds 9700000..9700511, release wheel, amm_sim_rs.run_batch(X, VanillaStrategy, configs, 8) with configs per MatchRunner._build_configs. Those seeds are for screening only.
(c) score.py: paired scoring against (b) in rounds of 128 seeds. It stops early when a candidate is clearly worse (mean + 3 se < 0) or, when asked, clearly above a bar, prints {n, mean_diff, se, worst5} each round, and works for replica and engine runs.
(d) setup_fast.sh: one command, pinned sha256 for every download, a reusable cache under $HOME/.cache/imd-amm, no Rust, prints its own timing; Linux x86_64, and macOS arm64 for replica work only.
(e) gatep.py: checks Taylor's files by sha256 and runs gates.py once per machine, caching the output by commit and Python version.
README.md: what each piece does, exact commands, and raw URLs at the final commit.
Rules: no command over 8 minutes (checkpoint and resume); state under scratch/; no engine seed outside 9700000..9700511; every item benchmarks first and caps its work to fit.
